identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Open-label, Single-center Clinical Study: Safety and Efficacy of Anti-CD7 CAR-T in the Treatment of Relapsed or Refractory T Cell Lymphoblastic Acute Leukemia/ Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is a single dose escalation and dose extension study. The main purpose of the IIT clinical trial is to evaluate the safety, tolerance, pharmacokinetic characteristics, and preliminary efficacy of CAR-T cells in r/r T-ALL/LBL subjects. The study includes two parts: the dose increasing stage (Part A) and the dose expanding stage (Part B) of CD7 CAR-T cell injection. The study plans to enroll 30 subjects, of which approximately 12-18 are planned to be enrolled in the dose escalation phase, and the remaining are planned to be enrolled in the dose escalation phase.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Counting from the beginning of cell transfusion until treatment failure, recurrence, or death (various causes). For patients without CR or CRi, EFS is calculated from the beginning of cell transfusion until disease progression or death. Based on the initial event.
